text:
maya: quick check — getting ready to apply a terraform change to move telemetry-uploader to IRSA + projected SA tokens. can someone scan the tf snippet + helm values? worried about role name length and pod config.

maya: tf snippet I'm about to apply:
```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "telemetry_irsa" {
  name = "telemetry-uploader-role-for-prod"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({/* oidc trust */})
}
```

maya: helm values I'm planning to merge (values.yaml):
```yaml
serviceAccount:
  create: true
  name: telemetry-uploader
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/telemetry-uploader-role-for-prod
pod:
  automountServiceAccountToken: true
containers:
  uploader:
    env:
      - name: AWS_ROLE_ARN
        valueFrom:
          serviceAccountToken:
            audience: sts.amazonaws.com
            expirationSeconds: 900
```

sam: quick notes — two things: 1) projected service account tokens don't require an extra custom annotation. only eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn is needed for IRSA (and the oidc provider trust). 2) make the role name shorter (AWS limit is 64 chars), your tf name looks fine but the full computed name might push it over if we add env-specific suffixes.

sam: also double-check the sts:aud condition in the assume role policy (should match the audience value you use from the pod: sts.amazonaws.com).

jia: +1 on shortening. i'd prefer "telemetry-uploader-role-prod" (under 40 chars) so we don't risk recreation when we append region/account markers later.

oz: small gotcha: setting pod.automountServiceAccountToken=false will break projected tokens — we need true. i see you have true, just flagging since some charts default to false.

maya: good call, thanks. i'll shorten the role name and update the assume role policy aud to sts.amazonaws.com.

infra-bot: terraform plan: 
-/+ resource aws_iam_role.telemetry_irsa will be replaced (forces new resource)
  + name: "telemetry-uploader-role-for-prod" -> "telemetry-uploader-role-prod"
(0 to add, 1 to change, 1 to destroy)

maya: infra-bot — that replacement is expected, correct? we will rotate role, then update pods to reference new role via annotation. any rollout suggestions?

deploy-bot: run the role apply during low-traffic window. after apply, do a rolling restart of deployment telemetry-uploader (kubectl rollout restart) so pods get the new token behavior. do canary on 5% of replicas first.

viv: pinging @eng-platform for a quick helm-values lgtm before i merge the chart change. i left a small comment in the PR about using value: serviceAccount.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] instead of hardcoding in templates.

sam: also check that our OIDC provider thumbprint is in sync in the aws_iam_openid_connect_provider resource — mismatch will cause AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity to fail.

maya: thanks all — i'll update TF and values, shorten the role, run plan again, then tag infra for apply. will post plan output here before applying. :thumbsup:

oz: if you want me to run the canary, ping me after apply.

maya: will do.

viv: lgtm from security side as long as we scope the role policy to the specific S3 prefixes and log group ARNs.

maya: noted — tightening policy before apply.

sam: thanks, appreciate the quick reviews.
